text:
Miguel Torres: hey @sofia — my PT clinic called, they said they need member ID + a pre-auth/reference number to bill. I moved recently and my new digital ID isn't showing up in their provider portal. appointment is tomorrow 8:30am. can People Ops issue a temporary proof of coverage or contact the clinic?

Sofia Chen: @miguel sorry you're in a crunch. can you DM me full name + DOB + last 4? i can pull the benefit summary and draft a clinic-facing cover letter they usually accept. also which plan do you see on your portal?

Miguel Torres: DM'ed — Miguel Torres / DOB 1988-05-11 / last4 8342. Portal shows 'Redwood Core PPO' but the clinic only sees 'Redwood Health' with no group #.

Sofia Chen: got it. tagging @kaitlyn to check with benefits/broker and see if we can get an authorization number or at least a printable proof letter. i'll prepare a temporary coverage PDF to send to the clinic. :thumbsup:

Kaitlyn Patel: hi all — i can take this. PT preauth usually needs the referral and expected number of sessions + CPT codes from the clinic. can they email that to benefits@redwood.com? if it's faster i'll call them directly. what's the clinic phone?

Miguel Torres: clinic main line is (415) 555-0129, ask for Bayfield PT billing/authorizations. they said they can accept a printable letter with member name, plan name, effective date, and group #, or just the member ID. they can also email referrals to billing@bayfieldpt.com.

Kaitlyn Patel: understood. i'll email the clinic now with a printable proof letter and cc our broker to fast-track preauth. miguel i'll copy you. typical turnaround is 24–48h but i'll mark urgent. if they call i'll confirm details.

Sofia Chen: miguel — as a stopgap i've exported a PDF of your digital ID from the vendor portal and attached it to the outgoing email. clinics usually accept that same-day for registration; preauth may still be pending but they'll schedule.

Miguel Torres: you two are lifesavers, thank you. quick question — if preauth isn't issued before the appointment, do i risk a big out-of-pocket? can't really reschedule.

Kaitlyn Patel: if the clinic can register you with the member ID and then enter an authorization number later, billing will be processed in-network once auth comes through. if they bill without preauth we can file an appeal/adjustment; keep all receipts and the visit note and we'll assist.

Sofia Chen: tagging @people-ops-bot to create a follow-up ticket and attach the letter so we can track this. :white_check_mark:

people-ops-bot: Ticket PT-215123 created and assigned to Kaitlyn Patel. ETA follow-up 48h.

Kaitlyn Patel: emailed billing@bayfieldpt.com with the proof letter, broker cc, and requested expedited preauth. copied miguel. i'll post back once the clinic replies.

Miguel Torres: got the email from Bayfield — they accepted the PDF ID and scheduled me. really appreciate the quick help!
